LOL — Larpers of Linux.

We’re four developers participating in the NASA Hackathon, bringing skills in C/C++, backend development, Laravel, PHP, Python (NumPy), JavaScript, Node.js, and HTML/CSS. We’re looking for a teammate with game development skills to help us build interactive solutions. We value creativity, problem-solving, collaboration, and the drive to experiment, learn, and turn ideas into reality.
